summary: WS-L: GLM substrate bakeoff — smoke, measure, pre-dispatch quantum/calc gate
armingNote: L0 smoke is DISARMED-safe. L1 zai-tmux needs Terminal+tmux. L3 measurement needs YURI_GLM_FLEET=1 and/or YURI_OLLAMA_FLEET=1 for armed runs. Pre-dispatch selector is pure/advisory — no arming.

subtasks.prompt: Smoke all substrates DISARMED where needed: (1) llm-lane glm-5.2 --no-tools, (2) lane-dispatch glm --no-tools, (3) glm-fleet --dry-run, (4) ollama-fleet --dry-run, (5) cline-fleet --dry-run, (6) native-spawn-loop dry-run stub. Record exit codes. Return 02L0_SUBSTRATE_SMOKE_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Document Marcel baseline: ai claude-zai via yuri-spawn-worker.sh. Manual one-shot 'Reply OK' task. Record cold-boot latency + pass. Append to bakeoff doc §J. Return 02L0_TMUX_BASELINE_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

IF bakeoff ranks tmux-zai #1 (expected): implement _SYSTEM/Scripts/zai-tmux-fleet.mjs wrapping yuri-spawn-worker.sh. ARM_ENV=YURI_ZAI_TMUX_FLEET. Packet shape matches glm-fleet. DISARMED unit test. Do NOT implement if L0 smoke reveals trivial llm-lane one-line fix instead. Return 02L1_ZAI_TMUX_ADAPTER_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Wire advisory substrate-pre-dispatch.mjs: score {tmux-zai, glm-fleet, ollama-flash, cline} via math-bridge.scoreOptions + decision-sim.robustScore. Simulate hypotheses with seeded draws. Log to prediction-ledger. quantum-hypothesis-tracker ONLY if order-sensitive escalation path added. Return 02L2_PRE_DISPATCH_SELECTOR_X_PASS_COMMITTED.
Wire pre-dispatch selector into runFleet.mjs dry-run output as routerSuggestions.substrateScore (advisory). Document in bakeoff doc §G. Return 02L2_RUNFLEET_HOOK_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Execute 10-prompt bakeoff per bakeoff doc §I. Measure latency p50/p95, pass rates, RESULT_LABEL yield per substrate. Update options matrix §C with measured scores. Feed mean/sd into pre-dispatch selector. Return 02L3_BAKEOFF_MEASURED_X_PASS_COMMITTED.

Cross-check chosen substrate stack against MURE_ENFORCEMENT_MINIMUM §B honesty invariants + §G orchestration. Confirm wait-for-job replaces blind sleep. Return 02L3_ENFORCEMENT_CROSSCHECK_X_PASS_COMMITTED.
